title: Run
description: A recorded run: the commands an operator sent to a chip, in time order. Written by operator/, replayed by twin/.

chip_spec.description: Repo-relative path of the chip spec this run used, e.g. chip/placeholder_chip_spec.json. The twin loads the chip from here.

placeholder.description: true when the protocol or chip spec it was made from is a placeholder.

t_s.description: Protocol time when the command starts, in seconds.

duration_s.description: How long the command takes, in seconds.

narration.description: One sentence shown in the twin's narration panel.

protocol_step.description: The protocol step this command carries out, or null.
